decisions.boundary_condition: Treat the balcony as a soft preference rather than a strict requirement; a first-floor room can be acceptable without one
decisions.canonical_value: Softly prefer hotel rooms with a balcony, especially above the first floor, while accepting otherwise suitable rooms without one.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize rooms with a balcony when available
decisions.exception_condition: Do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely because a balcony is unavailable
decisions.name: hotel_room_balcony_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer a room with a balcony
decisions.rationale: Multiple hotel-selection examples support a recurring soft preference for a balcony. The evidence also supplies a clear first-floor boundary and indicates that balcony availability should not determine suitability by itself.
